groups.name: Adult Faith Formation
groups.description: From bible studies and potlucks to volunteer opportunities and intergenerational education nights, St. John’s offers a wide array of Adult Faith Formation programming to help parishioners continue to grow in the Catholic faith.

groups.name: Pastoral Ministry, Outreach, and Evangelization
groups.description: This program is dedicated to serving the spiritual, physical, and emotional needs of both our parishioners and the broader community. In alignment with the Gospel teachings of Jesus Christ, this ministry actively engages in outreach efforts to foster a compassionate…

groups.name: Pro-Life Representative
groups.description: This person keeps St. John’s aware of the pro-life activities going on in the Omaha Archdiocese. Activities may range from praying in front of Planned Parenthood to the Life Chain in October where all churches in the archdiocese are represented.…

groups.name: Bereavement Ministry
groups.description: This ministry is committed to providing compassionate support to families during times of loss. With a focus on healing and remembrance, this ministry plays a crucial role in guiding families through the grieving process.

groups.name: St. Michael’s Ministry
groups.description: This ministry builds on our parish mission of being a warm and welcoming place by providing enhanced opportunities for attendees at Mass and other events to access assistance ranging from worship service information, facility questions, or medical and safety needs.
